title: obs-iac-upgrade-inspector-and-health-gates
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a Terraform module and accompanying operator-style checks to make rolling upgrades of the VPC observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, and log-shippers) safe and automatable. The 'upgrade-inspector' module will provide pre-upgrade validation hooks, in-flight health gates, and an automated rollback plan integration for Helm/Terraform-driven upgrades in customer VPCs. Goals: reduce upgrade incidents caused by config drift, verify log-forwarding and OTLP pipelines before cutting traffic, and offer an auditable runbook for private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Create a reusable Terraform module 'observability/upgrade-inspector' that can be included by customer VPC stacks

Pre-upgrade validations run as a Terraform external data check or Kubernetes Job and fail the plan/apply when critical checks (Prom scrape health, OTLP sink connectivity, log-shipping backlog) are not met
During canary upgrades, the module exposes a health-gate API and PrometheusAlerts query that the rollout automation polls to decide enable/disable of subsequent batches

Provide an automated rollback trigger integrated with the rollout controller (via a Kubernetes Job or Terraform-run hook) that reverts Helm releases or restores previous Terraform state when SLO regressions exceed thresholds
Upgrade documentation and runbook published in Confluence with exact PromQL and example Terraform include usage
E2E test harness: a GH Actions workflow that runs upgrades against a lightweight KIND cluster and verifies health gate logic and rollback path
Module should not require changes to customer's application manifests and should support both Helm and direct Kubernetes manifests for observability components
notes: This ticket bundles infra code, small operator glue, and runbook authoring. Keep the module boundary narrow: no opinionated dashboards or alerting changes — only health signals and gating. Avoid coupling to internal rollout operator; provide a simple webhook and a Kubernetes Job contract so partner operators (Argo Rollouts, custom controllers) can integrate.
implementation_plan: Design phase: enumerate health checks and failure modes (Prometheus TSDB scrape errors, remote_write failures, OTLP exporter connectivity, vector/fluentd queue backlog). Draft PromQL and probe definitions
Prototype: terraform module that creates a 'upgrade-checker' k8s Job and a Service exposing /health-gates; Job executes pre/post-upgrade probes using curl and promql queries via prometheus HTTP API
Integration: add Helm hook/terraform null_resource that triggers the pre-upgrade Job and polls the /health-gates endpoint during canary windows

Rollback: implement a terraform null_resource or controller-triggered Job that executes helm rollback or terraform apply -target to restore previous release state and posts an incident message to Slack via webhook
Testing: GH Actions matrix for Helm versions, OTLP collector versions, and with simulated log-backlog using flent to push logs
Docs: Confluence page + example usage snippet for customers to include module and set thresholds
risks_and_mitigations: False positives from transient scrape failures -> mitigate: require sustained failure for N consecutive windows (configurable)
Terraform run-time limits for long polling -> mitigate: offload polling to lightweight k8s Job and keep terraform hooks synchronous only for pre-upgrade validation
Rollback safety when state drift exists -> mitigate: add dry-run validation and an explicit 'force-rollback' flag, and require manual approval for destructive reverts
Customer RBAC constraints in Private deployments -> mitigate: module has an opt-in ServiceAccount template and minimal RBAC scope documented
comments: 2026-02-11 Aisha Kapoor: Created ticket. Initial design doc uploaded to Confluence. Listed core checks: prometheus scrape health, remote_write status, otlp exporter connectivity, vector backlog size.

2026-02-18 Tomas Rivera: Spike complete. Prototype Job that runs promql queries and posts a simple JSON result to /health-gates. Found that some managed Prometheus endpoints rate-limit API queries during upgrades; recommend reducing promql window and caching answers in the Job pod.

2026-02-26 Linnea Olsen (Review): Reviewed prototype. Feedback: make thresholds configurable via Terraform variables and expose a 'canary-window' duration. Also request to log all probe outputs to a configured S3/GCS path for auditability.

2026-03-03 Jae Park: Implemented helm rollback helper as a Kubernetes Job that runs 'helm rollback' and then re-applies previous values via s3-stored dump. Opened PR #261 for initial module code. Still working on GH Actions E2E matrix.

2026-03-09 Tomas Rivera: Integration test flake observed when KIND cluster CPU throttles Prometheus; added retry backoff and increased default scrape timeout. Updated acceptance criteria to require sustained failure checks.
2026-03-12 Aisha Kapoor: PM review scheduled. Need to finalize runbook steps and Slack incident template. Assigned docs task to Sarah Nguyen.
2026-03-12 Tomas Rivera: NOTE: adding dependency on ENG-98107 (telemetry iac-upgrade-guardian) to coordinate shared webhook schemas and alert labels.
